dedupe_keys.name: jrc 2017 techno economics for larger heating and cooling technologies

description: This JRC data set provides data and projections for large-scale district heating technologies, with an outlook to 2050 and regional differences. It was produced for the Joint Research Centre of the European Commission by Christopher Binder, Robert Große, Roman Geyer, Stefan Wöll and Steffen Robbi, and complements a JRC study on smaller heating and cooling technologies. It covers the parameters needed for technical and economic assessment and system modelling: efficiency, capital and operating costs, and emissions of pollutants such as carbon dioxide, sulphur dioxide, nitrogen oxides and particles. Technologies include boilers, electric resistance heating, geothermal, solar thermal, heat pumps, combined heat and power and fuel cells. Coverage is the European Union with regional differences, from the 2017 base to 2050. The file is downloadable from the JRC Data Catalogue, issued in November 2017, with no access limitations under the European Commission reuse notice (CC-BY-4.0) at no cost. Caveats: values date from 2017, and cost projections carry large uncertainty. Simulation uses are technology parameters for district heating and energy system planning models. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
